text: You did it! You won the Thailand Explorer trophy!

A gecko! It sings took-geh, took-geh!

Elephants live in the north of Thailand!
It rains a lot in Nan's mountains!
Gibbons swing through the jungle! Whoop whoop!
Water buffalo help on the rice farms!
A hornbill! Look at its big beak!
Dolphins swim in the Gulf of Thailand!
A longtail boat! Its motor has a long tail!
Coconuts grow on palm trees by the sea!

A shoe on your head! Hee hee!

It's too full! Sit on it!

Put your suitcase on the belt!

Look! The sky is turning pink!

A longtail has a car engine on a stick!
The sea nibbled a notch in the rock!
Houses on stilts, over the sea!
The kids here built a football field that floats!
Hong means room, a secret room!
Mangrove trees stand on their roots!
Boats stay back so the Nail Island keeps standing!
A needlefish! It skips over the water!
A sea eagle! It fishes with its feet!
The village cat lives on a boat!

An elephant's trunk is its nose and its hand!
Elephants eat almost all day long!

Pack again, or go straight to the boat?
Sawasdee krap! Welcome to my farm!
Let me tell you what Jip did last year.
My rice was all golden. So I had a little nap...
The birds thought I was the scarecrow!
This year, I need a helper. Will you help me?
My old hat! Jip made a nest!
Let's share our rice with them!
One for you, one for me!
Sawasdee krap! I need a helper!
Oh no! It's Jip and friends!
Now we bang the grains out!
Walk through the water to plant!
Rice likes water! Open the gate.
Walk through the rice to cut it!
Tap the rice to share it!
Click the rice to share it!
In Nan, people eat sticky rice with their fingers!
The steps on the hill keep the water for the rice!
Buffalo helped farmers get the mud ready!
Ducks eat the bugs in the rice!
Tap the gate to let the water in!
Click the gate to let the water in!
Want to see real farmers grow rice?
Tap a place to drive there!
Click a place to drive there!
Over there is Laos, another country!
Steer the car with your finger!
Click and drag to steer the car!
Put your mushrooms on the pizza!
Hold your finger on the bags!
Click and hold on the bags!
Pull a mushroom into the basket!
Drag a mushroom to the pizza!
Tap the pizza to share it!
Click the pizza to share it!
Mushrooms grow from sawdust, not seeds!
Dip the bucket in the well!
Put a log on the fire!
Pull the bucket down into the well!
Carry it over the big pan!
Throw a log in the fire!
Move the paddle through the salt!
The water boils away, and the salt stays!
Sawasdee ka! I'm Pa Kluea. I make the salt!
Blehh! My soup tastes like puddle water!
Bawk! My salty eggs aren't salty!
And my fish is so... plain.
Oh no! My salt jar is empty!
And the village dinner is tonight!
When I was little, my grandma made the salt.
And I carried it to every pot!
Will you be my salt carrier?
It's dinner time! Quick, salt carrier!
Sprinkle the salt on the food!
Now my eggs will be salty!
Thank you, salt carrier! The best dinner ever!
Hold your finger over the food!
Click and hold over the food!
Salt keeps eggs and fish yummy!
Sawasdee ka! I won three Cups!
Tortoises can live to be more than a hundred!
Hornbills have a big helmet on their beak!
Sun bears are the smallest bears!
Hold your finger on the road to go!
Click and hold on the road to go!
Hold your finger on the road!
Click and hold on the road!
You beat me up my mountain!
Tap the winner for a high five!
Click the winner for a high five!
Great race! A honey sticker for you!
The Nan Mountain Cup! Tap it!
The Nan Mountain Cup! Click it!
You are the Nan Mountain Cup champion!
It's cool and rainy in the mountains!
Pink mushroom sticker! Mushrooms love the rain.
Nan is in the mountains, next to Laos!
This big car was made in Thailand!
Mushrooms aren't plants! They love dark, wet places.
Bo Kluea makes salt from a well!
Long ago the sea was here, and it left its salt!
A pink flower grows on the mountain, only in Nan!
Doi Phu Kha is a big mountain in Nan!
Pink mermaid sticker! A mermaid sits on the rocks!
The samet tree gave the island its name!
The mermaid is from an old Thai poem!
Koh Samet is a national park, a home for animals!
Always wear a life jacket on the water!
The sun sets in the west, over Ao Prao!
Fireflies glow to say hello to each other!
Oh no, oh no, oh no!
Every night, four fireflies light up our fire show.
But last night, a big wind came. Whoosh!
It blew them all over the island!
But Tofu saw where they went!
Will you help us find them?
Four fireflies to find! Tap a picture!
Four fireflies to find! Click a picture!
Look! A pink light on the water!
Something is glowing in the sand!
A blue light, far out at sea!
A green light in the big tree!
One firefly! Three more to find!
Two fireflies! Two more to find!
Tofu the beach puppy! He saw it all!
Sawasdee krap! Looking for a pink light?
She zoomed round my buoys all night!
She only stops for someone fast!
Look! Something's glowing in the sand!
A little gold firefly! She is shy.
A castle fit for a firefly!
A little blue light fell in the sea!
She can't swim! She is in a bubble.
Down by the coral. Can you find her?
A blue glow! Swim to it!
The cuttlefish is hugging her bubble!
Did you see that? A green light!
She is playing hide and seek!
The green light knows where Dad is!
Shh! She is hiding with you!
All four fireflies! You did it!
It's so dark. No show tonight.
And these lights are for you!
Khob khun ka! Come back soon!
Hat Sai Kaew! The jet ski beach!
Ao Hin Khok! Build a sandcastle!
Ao Phai! A quiet little bay!
Ao Wong Duan! The snorkel boat!
Ao Prao! The big driftwood tree!
Ao Noi Na! Look at the boats!
The jet ski is yours now! Hop on!
Sunset time! To the big tree!
Thank you for cleaning the beach!
The puppy wants you to come!
Hold on tight! Off you go!
Click and drag to steer it!
Ha ha! Boats go in the sea!
To get off, drive into the pink ring!
The rope keeps the swimmers safe!
Hold your finger on the water!
Click and hold on the water!
Go round the big orange buoy!
Dig the sand with your finger!
Click and drag to dig the sand!
Dig sand into a bucket, then tap it!
Dig sand into a bucket, then click it!
The sea is coming! Dig a river to it!
The sea comes up the beach and goes back, twice a day!
A ghost crab! It runs sideways!
Drag your finger in the sand!
Click and drag in the sand!
Dig a line down to the sea!
Dig next to a bucket to fill it!
Hold your finger in the water to swim!
Click and hold in the water to swim!
Tap the cuttlefish to swim to it!
Click the cuttlefish to swim to it!
It turned pink, just for you!
Tap the camera for a photo!
Click the camera for a photo!
Coral is alive! Fish live in it.
My boat waits for you, ka!
Tap the parrotfish to follow it!
Click the parrotfish to follow it!
Tap the roll to take a bite!
Click the roll to take a bite!
Hold your finger on the coconut!
Click and hold on the coconut!
My turn to count! Go hide!
Hee hee! I can see your tail!
Where is she? I give up!
Look! The sun is going to sleep!
Pull the sun down into the sea!
The sun always sets in the west!
Tap the fire for the show!
Click the fire for the show!
Swirl your lights with your finger!
Click and drag to swirl your lights!
Fire is for grown-ups. Yours are lights!
It floats up like a lantern!
Swirl a loop! Something is coming!
Swirl your finger in the sky!
Click and drag to swirl in the sky!
Follow the dots with your finger!
Click and drag along the dots!

Welcome to HarborLand! Click a place to play!
A puppy with a sore paw! Grab a tool!
A baby elephant with a sniffly trunk!
Everyone is better! Thank you, Doctor!
The thermometer goes in its mouth!
Pull out the thorn with the tweezers!
Rub cream on the sore paw!
Click and wiggle cream on the sore paw!
Wrap a bandage round the paw!
Click and wiggle on lots of soap!
An x-ray shows the bones inside!
Grab a tool and do his hair!
Now colors and the hair dryer!
Squirt the grow tonic on his hair!
A spinning pole means haircuts here!
Lift the jar and pour it in the cup!
Make the drink in the bubble!
Thai drinks! Two cups at once!
Put a straw in the cup!
Drop in the fruit from the bubble!
Cha yen is Thai iced tea! It's orange!

A slide race! Click the steps to climb!
Tap, tap, tap to go fast!
Click, click, click to go fast!
Now tap at each bump to fly!
Now click at each bump to fly!
Can you build higher than me?

Put a brick on the picture!
Tap the tower to push it!
Click the tower to push it!

Climb the Golden Mountain! Count the holds!
In Bangkok, the Golden Mount has over 300 steps!
In Lopburi, monkeys live all over town!
Sawasdee krap! First we say thank you.
The wai kru dance says thank you to your teacher!
Muay Thai is Thailand's own sport!
In Thai, one, two, three is nueng, song, saam!
Climb up high, then slide down!
Phi Ta Khon is a festival with big funny masks!
Tap a slide to ride it!
Click a slide to ride it!
Sharing fairly means everyone gets the same!
Pull a slice to a plate!
Ho ho ho! Look at Dad's hair!
Tap Agong to give him the box!
Click Agong to give him the box!
Welcome to HarborLand! Socks on, please!
ICONSIAM is by the Chao Phraya river!
At HarborLand, everyone wears grip socks!
Lopburi is a town full of monkeys!
The Golden Mount is a temple on a hill in Bangkok!
Muay Thai boxers dance the wai kru to thank their teacher!
Cha yen is Thai iced tea. It's orange!
